table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invcode = dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode, 
	serviceinvcode = dbo.servicerheader.serviceinvcode, 
	date      = dbo.servicerheader.date,    
	flatdisc  = dbo.servicerheader.flatdisc, 
	misccharges = dbo.servicerheader.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.servicerheader.discperc, 
	doctype = Case dbo.servicerheader.servicercatcode When 15 Then 'Cash' When 14 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name + ' (' + P.RegNo + ')' FROM Patient P  WHERE P.PatientCode=servicerheader.patientcode),
	UserName = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=servicerheader.salesmancode),
	amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.servicerdetail.qty * dbo.servicerdetail.serviceprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.servicerdetail.qty * (dbo.servicerdetail.serviceprice - dbo.servicerdetail.serviceflatdisc) * (dbo.servicerdetail.discperc * .01)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.servicerdetail.qty * (dbo.servicerdetail.serviceprice - dbo.servicerdetail.serviceflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.servicerdetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.servicerheader.discperc /100), 2),
	tax = 
			Round(Sum((servicerdetail.qty * (servicerdetail.serviceprice - servicerdetail.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicerdetail.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * servicerdetail.servicegstPerc ) +
			Sum(servicerdetail.qty * servicerdetail.serviceflattax ) +
			Round((Sum(servicerdetail.qty * (servicerdetail.serviceprice - servicerdetail.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicerdetail.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - servicerheader.discperc * 0.01)) - servicerheader.flatdisc )*0.01* servicerheader.serviceinvgstperc, 2) ,0)
FROM 
	dbo.servicerheader, 
	dbo.servicerdetail,   
	dbo.accounts
WHERE 
	( dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode = dbo.servicerdetail.servicerinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.servicerheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.servicerheader.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
GROUP BY 
	dbo.servicerheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.servicerheader.flatdisc,   
	dbo.servicerheader.date,   
	dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode,   
	dbo.servicerheader.serviceinvcode,   
	dbo.servicerheader.discperc,  
	dbo.servicerheader.servicercatcode, 
	dbo.servicerheader.serviceinvgstperc,
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.servicerheader.patientcode,
	servicerheader.salesmancode
ORDER BY 
	dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode ASC,   
	dbo.servicerheader.date ASC

objects.name: netamount
objects.expression: Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  + tax
